info.name: Flwn Data Engine
info.description:
Domain CRUD API of the Flwn data engine (users, organizations, members, workspaces, teams, projects, work items, sprints, tasks).

Auth: header X-Data-API-Key ({{apiKey}}), set at collection level. Tenant: header X-Organization-Id ({{orgId}}) is added automatically by a collection pre-request script to every request EXCEPT /users... and /organizations... (those take the organization from the path or have none). A request that sets the header itself keeps its own value.

Start with the 'Full flow' folder in the Collection Runner.

exec: // Tenant header: everything except /users... and /organizations... is scoped by X-Organization-Id.

item.name: Users
item.description: Global login accounts. No X-Organization-Id needed. Users are never deleted.

request.description: Email is stored lowercased; a duplicate (any case) returns 409 USER_ALREADY_EXISTS.
Exact match on the lowercased email. Returns a page with 0 or 1 items; `email` is required.
404 USER_NOT_FOUND if unknown.
Only the fields you send change.
The user's Member rows across all organizations.

item.name: Organizations
item.description: POST /organizations and /organizations/{orgId}/... take the organization from the body/path, so the org header is not sent.

request.description: One transaction: the organization plus the creator's HUMAN member (role defaults to OWNER). Unknown createdById returns 422 INVALID_REFERENCE and nothing is saved.
404 ORGANIZATION_NOT_FOUND if unknown.
`archived: true` sets archivedAt, `false` clears it.
DELETE archives (sets archivedAt); it does not remove the row.

item.name: Members
item.description: A membership in an organization: HUMAN (has a user) or AI (no user). There is no DELETE for members.

request.description: AI needs a name (unique per org, case-insensitive); email optional.
HUMAN needs userId and no name/email. A user can join an org once.
Filters (enable as needed): type, status, role, workspaceId.
name/email of a HUMAN come from the User.
workspaceId: null clears the home department. type/userId cannot change.
Team memberships of the member.
Distinct projects of the member's teams (any department).
Tasks assigned to the member across projects; optional status filter.
Name unique per organization among non-archived workspaces (case-insensitive).
Archived rows are included unless `archived` is set.
`archived: true` sets archivedAt, `false` clears it.
DELETE archives, it doesn't remove.

item.name: Teams
item.description: Teams belong to a workspace; members and projects can come from any department of the same org.

request.description: Name unique per workspace among non-archived teams.
Archived rows are included unless `archived` is set.
DELETE archives, it doesn't remove.
Role defaults to MEMBER. Adding twice returns 409 TEAM_MEMBER_ALREADY_EXISTS.
Hard delete of the membership (the member stays).
Projects this team works on.

item.name: Projects
item.description: Owned by one department. The key (e.g. FLWN) is permanent and unique per org, archived projects included.

request.description: key must match ^[A-Z]{2,10}$.
Filters: archived, status. Archived rows are included by default.
The key cannot be changed (422).
DELETE archives, it doesn't remove.
The team may belong to any workspace of the same org.
Hard delete. 409 PROJECT_TEAM_HAS_SPRINTS while the team still has sprints in the project.

item.name: Work items
item.description: Optional grouping of tasks (feature / story / bug).

request.description: type is required; priority defaults to MEDIUM, status to OPEN.
Filters: status, type, priority.
Hard delete. Its tasks are kept with workItemId = null.

item.name: Sprints
item.description: A sprint belongs to one team inside one project.

request.description: The team must already be on the project (404 PROJECT_TEAM_NOT_FOUND). Only one ACTIVE sprint per team per project.
Filters: teamId, status.
Setting ACTIVE while another sprint of the team is ACTIVE returns 409 SPRINT_ALREADY_ACTIVE.
Hard delete. Its tasks are kept with sprintId = null (back to the backlog).

item.name: Tasks
item.description: Numbered per project (1, 2, 3...), identified by key like FLWN-12. Numbers are never reused.

request.description: number and key are assigned by the server. dueDate must carry a timezone. status DONE requires completedAt.
Ordered by number. Filters: status, priority, assigneeId, sprintId, workItemId, backlog=true (no sprint).
Key format PROJECTKEY-NUMBER, looked up inside the header's organization.
Only sent fields change. DONE <=> completedAt must hold (422 on completedAt otherwise).
Hard delete. The number is not reused.
